Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.
With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.
 About Atos Group
 Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.
We are looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented QA Tester who is passionate about delivering high-quality software solutions.
Location Brasov, Romania.
Work model Hybrid
This role focuses primarily on service maintenance, incident fixes, enhancements and development support activities, ensuring the stability and reliability of existing business-critical applications. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with a structured testing approach, excellent communication skills and a commitment to continuous quality improvement throughout the service support lifecycle.
 Key Responsibilities
 Test Planning & Execution 
 Analyze business requirements, user stories and technical specifications to identify testing needs.
 Design, develop and maintain test cases, test scenarios, test scripts and test documentation.
 Execute manual and automated testing activities to validate system functionality and business processes.
 Perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, usability and end-to-end testing.
 Validate software functionality and integrations with project-specific hardware, including RFID printers, handheld devices and other related operational equipment.
 Defect Management
 Identify, reproduce, document and prioritize software defects.
 Provide detailed defect reports, including reproduction steps, expected results, actual results and supporting evidence.
 Collaborate closely with project teams to investigate, troubleshoot and resolve issues.
 Retest resolved defects and validate the effectiveness of implemented fixes.
 Continuous Improvement
 Contribute to the enhancement of QA processes, testing methodologies and documentation standards.
 Share best practices and lessons learned with project teams.
 Support the adoption of quality-driven approaches throughout the service support lifecycle.
 Technical Skills
 Required Skills & Competencies
 Experience in designing and executing manual test cases and test scenarios.
 Basic understanding of automated testing frameworks, particularly Java and Selenium.
 Good knowledge of functional, regression, integration, exploratory and usability testing.
 Experience working with defect tracking and test management tools.
 Basic understanding of web applications, APIs, databases and client-server architectures.
 Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or other iterative development methodologies.
 Comfortable maintaining and working directly with required hardware components, including RFID printers, Android handheld devices and other required equipment.
 Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
 Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis capabilities.
 Ability to identify potential quality risks and recommend mitigation measures.
 Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
 Communication & Collaboration
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability to clearly articulate technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Experience collaborating with developers, business analysts, product owners and other project teams.
 Personal Attributes
 Quality-focused mindset with a proactive attitude.
 Strong organizational and time-management skills.
 Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within distributed teams.
 Continuous learning mindset and willingness to adapt to changing project requirements.
 Qualifications & Experience
 Proven experience in Manual Testing and Quality Assurance.
 Basic knowledge of test automation concepts and tools.
 Hands-on experience with test case design, execution and defect management.
 Experience testing web-based and enterprise applications.
 Experience with API testing tools such as Postman.
 Familiarity with testing and project management platforms such as Jira, TestLink, or similar tools.
 Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
 Ability to translate business requirements into effective testing scenarios and validation activities.
 Good command of English, both written and spoken.
 Nice to Have
 Exposure to MS SQL Server and database validation.
 Experience working in cloud-based environments.
 ISTQB Foundation Level certification or equivalent QA certification.
 Experience with hardware testing.
 Why Join Us?
 You will be part of a collaborative team where quality is a shared responsibility. This role offers the
opportunity to contribute to the delivery of reliable software solutions, influence quality processes and continuously develop your testing expertise in a dynamic environment.
 Rewards And Benefits
Opportunity to work on long-term, complex international projects.
Exposure to modern technologies and structured delivery environments.
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
Career growth within a stable and collaborative environment
Wellbeing programs & work-life balance initiatives.
Benefits platform - culture, shopping, sport and more.
Continuous learning programs and online courses.
Possibility to participate in charity and eco initiatives.
